title.zh: 有限责任合伙（第 19A(1)(d) 条下的指示）公告 2015
title.en: Limited Liability Partnerships (Direction under section 19A(1)(d)) Notification 2015

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Notification may be cited as the Limited Liability Partnerships (Direction under section 19A(1)(d)) Notification 2015 and comes into operation on 3 January 2016.

2.—(1) The Minister directs that, subject to sub-paragraph (2), the Registrar must not accept for registration under the Act any name containing the word “Temasek”.
(2) Sub-paragraph (1) does not apply if a partner or prospective partner of the limited liability partnership or proposed limited liability partnership is Temasek Holdings (Private) Limited, a company incorporated under the Companies Act (Cap. 50) (Registration No. 197401143C).
3. The Direction under section 19(1)(d) (Dir 1) is revoked.
